title: Baksa
sub: From Assampedia, the free Assam encyclopedia
body:
Baksa is a district in the Bodoland Territorial Region, in western Assam, with its headquarters at Mushalpur.

Geography

Baksa lies between the Brahmaputra and the Bhutan foothills, watered by the Beki and Pagladia rivers, and includes parts of Manas National Park in its north.

Life

The district is agricultural, with rice, jute and mustard, and is known for its Bodo, Assamese and other communities, and for weaving and bamboo crafts.
